ValidationRule.description: Restricts Sales users from selecting some restricted values in Reason Closed picklist.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Reason_Closed__c), OR( $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'WC_Sales_User', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'WCSalesTeamMgr', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Broker_Relations_Manager', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'WC_Sales_User', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Renewal_Sales', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Renewal_Sales_Manager' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Reason_Closed__c,'Deal Unwind'), ISPICKVAL(Reason_Closed__c,'Unconfirmed Documents'), ISPICKVAL(Reason_Closed__c,'Customer Service Issue'), ISPICKVAL(Reason_Closed__c,'Docs In Review – Decline'), ISPICKVAL(Reason_Closed__c,'Double Funding'), ISPICKVAL(Reason_Closed__c,'Poor Pay History – Competitor') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Restricted Reason Closed value. Please change the Reason Closed to a different selection or contact Operations for more information.
